incidents.name: Halvik storm surge
incidents.summary: Red storm surge warning; sea level at Old Harbour may peak at 2.1 m around 18:00. Saltmarsh residents south of Ferry Street must leave by 16:00. Harbour Bridge closed. 6 rumours contradicted.

highlights.title: Saltmarsh residents south of Ferry Street must leave by 16:00
Red storm surge warning issued for Halvik
